title: Seceda & the Dolomites
route: Brescia → Ortisei → Seceda → Sella Ronda → Selva di Val Gardena
introTitle: Into the heart of the Dolomites.
intro: Travel from Brescia to Ortisei for views from the Seceda cableways and the dramatic Odle ridgeline. Enjoy lunch in Ortisei before a scenic drive through the Dolomites, following the Sella Ronda mountain passes as conditions and time allow. Finish at Passo Gardena for beautiful late-afternoon scenery before spending the night in Selva di Val Gardena.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Begin in Brescia and drive north toward Val Gardena and the Dolomites.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Park in Ortisei and take the cableways toward Seceda.

stops.name: Seceda
stops.description: Enjoy the iconic Odle ridgeline and panoramic Alpine scenery.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Descend by cableway to Ortisei and enjoy lunch before the mountain drive.

stops.name: Passo Sella
stops.description: Admire the dramatic Sassolungo and Sella massif scenery from this mountain pass.

stops.name: Passo Pordoi
stops.description: Continue through the mountain landscape over Passo Pordoi if conditions and time permit.

stops.name: Arabba
stops.description: Pass through the mountain village of Arabba on the scenic Sella Ronda route.

stops.name: Passo Campolongo
stops.description: Cross Passo Campolongo toward Alta Badia if following the complete loop.

stops.name: Corvara
stops.description: Continue through Corvara, surrounded by the peaks of Alta Badia.

stops.name: Passo Gardena
stops.description: A memorable final scenic stop, especially beautiful in the late-afternoon light.

stops.name: Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Continue down into Selva di Val Gardena for the night.
